017package org.apache.juneau.console.views;
018
019import java.io.*;
020import java.util.*;
021
022import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
025
026/**
027 * Mixin interface that serves the terminal-view events endpoint.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * The abstract methods are the application's access rules and resolver, which is where authorization lives: an
031 * unknown id and a forbidden id both answer {@code 404}, so ids cannot be enumerated.  Run ids are opaque URL tokens matching
032 * {@code ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$}; anything else answers {@code 400} before the resolver runs.
033 *
034 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
035 * <p class='bjava'>
036 *    <ja>@Rest</ja>
037 *    <jk>public class</jk> RunsResource <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestServlet <jk>implements</jk> TerminalViewMixin {
038 *       <ja>@Override</ja>
039 *       <jk>public</jk> TerminalViewAccess terminalViewAccess() {
040 *          <jk>return</jk> (<jv>req</jv>, <jv>runId</jv>) -&gt; <jv>req</jv>.getUserPrincipal() != <jk>null</jk>;
041 *       }
042 *       <ja>@Override</ja>
043 *       <jk>public</jk> Optional&lt;TerminalViewSource&gt; terminalViewSource(String <jv>runId</jv>, RestRequest <jv>req</jv>) {
044 *          <jk>return</jk> <jf>runs</jf>.find(<jv>runId</jv>).map(Run::events);
045 *       }
046 *    }
047 * </p>
048 */
049public interface TerminalViewMixin {
050
051   /** The URL path prefix for the terminal-view endpoint (relative to the host mount). */
052   String RUN_VIEW_PREFIX = "/juneau-terminal-view";
053
054   /** The URL path template of the events endpoint. */
055   String EVENTS_PATH = RUN_VIEW_PREFIX + "/{runId}/events";
056
057   /**
058    * Resolves the source for a run id, applying the application's own access rules.
059    *
060    * @param runId The run id from the URL path (already checked against the grammar).
061    * @param req The in-flight request.
062    * @return The source, or empty when the id is unknown or the caller may not read it.
063    */
064   Optional<TerminalViewSource> terminalViewSource(String runId, RestRequest req);
065
066   /**
067    * The access rules applied to the events endpoint before the source is resolved.
068    *
069    * <p>
070    * A caller that may not read the run is answered {@code 404}, the same as an unknown id.  There is no default:
071    * every host states who may read.
072    *
073    * @return The access rules.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
074    */
075   TerminalViewAccess terminalViewAccess();
076
077   /**
078    * [GET /juneau-terminal-view/{runId}/events] &mdash; one page of events as JSON.
079    *
080    * @param runId The run id.
081    * @param req The request.
082    * @param res The response.
083    * @throws IOException If the response could not be written.
084    */
085   @RestGet(path=EVENTS_PATH, summary="Terminal view events", serializers=JsonSerializer.class, swagger=@OpSwagger(ignore=true))
086   default void terminalViewEvents(@Path("runId") String runId, RestRequest req, RestResponse res) throws IOException {
087      var checked = TerminalViewEndpoints.checkRunId(runId);
088      var source = terminalViewAccess().canView(req, checked) ? terminalViewSource(checked, req) : Optional.<TerminalViewSource>empty();
089      TerminalViewEndpoints.events(source, req, res);
090   }
091}
